'''FC Hebar''' ({{langx|bg|Футболен клуб Хебър}}) is a [[Bulgaria]]n professional [[Association football|football]] club based in [[Pazardzhik]]. The club currently competes in the [[Second Professional Football League (Bulgaria)|Second League]], the second tier of the [[Bulgarian football league system]].

Founded in 1918, Hebar has played at their current home ground, [[Stadion Georgi Benkovski]], since 1989. Hebar has played a total of five seasons in the top level of Bulgarian football, most recently in 2024-25. In 2001, despite finishing ninth in the A Group that season (club's highest finish), the owners of the club moved the assets of the club to [[Petrich]], reforming [[OFC Belasitsa Petrich|Belasitsa Petrich]]. Fans from Pazardzhik re-founded the club the same year, starting from the amateur levels."}}
